text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Please let me run once more! I... 
I don't ever want to lose again!

text_block_list.name: Mid-tier Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I feel the exact same way! Let's do our 
best together!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I can still keep going! I can 
take a heavier workload!

text_block_list.name: Mid-tier Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
If you want to win, you mustn't rush. 
Let's take our time and get your body used 
to the current load first!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(Their diligent devotion is truly 
admirable. Even when faced with high 
obstacles, they gaze straight ahead and 
pour their full effort into overcoming 
them.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(No matter how many victories one attains, 
one must never forget one's original 
resolve, nor neglect one's efforts.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Watching them serves as a poignant 
reminder—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
I really wanna play darts today~. This 
time, we're definitely gonna beat you, 
senpai!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Talk is cheap.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl D
text_block_list.text: Ehh!? That's mean, senpai! ...Wait, ah...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, Sirius. Running into you after 
school like this is a fortuitous encounter 
indeed.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah. To think the Lord "Emperor" herself 
would deign to greet me. Your gracious 
concern is truly overwhelming.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
However, I'm not so free as to stand 
around exchanging pleasantries with you. 
—Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text: Ah, right! Well then, excuse us!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Farewell.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl E
text_block_list.text:
Those rumors about the senpais not getting 
along were actually true...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl F
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It's kind of... disappointing, or 
rather... sad, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(On bad terms, is it? Just when was it... 
that we began to clash so pointlessly like 
that?)

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
『Whoa, that was amazing...! Do that 
again! How you stretched out your arm... 
It was just like a sharp sword! Hey, dance 
some more for me!』

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(...Is it because we both developed things 
we simply cannot yield to the other?)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(Has what was born between us, and 
everything built upon it over time, grown 
boundless and vast as the heavens 
themselves?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, I spotted 
Symboli Rudolf. She seemed somewhat lost 
in gloom, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm? No, it is nothing of grave importance. 
Forgive me for making you worry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even with her reassurance, I couldn't help 
but feel concerned. Perhaps sensing my 
worry from my expression, Symboli Rudolf 
gave a wry smile and began to explain.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —And so, that is the situation.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Many are drawn to her charismatic presence 
and way of being. And as the Student 
Council President, I stand in this academy 
to forge a path that guides many forward.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If two such figures were to constantly 
clash, it would only foster needless 
anxiety among the students.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For the vibrant vitality of our academy to 
wither into desolate autumn winds on our 
account is something neither I nor she 
would ever desire.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even so, mending our relationship is by no 
means a simple matter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gazing out at the evening glow, Symboli 
Rudolf offered another faint, 
self-deprecating smile.
